purpose: Test whether v6 task drift is primarily movement among complementary nearby parameter basins before changing training or compiler architecture.

derivation.deployment: one inference-only Writer state, one load, one Writer forward per video

candidates.name: uniform_m150_m200
candidates.rationale: average the local high-performing neighborhood around the raw observed best

candidates.name: uniform_m200_m400
candidates.rationale: average complementary early and late task-allocation modes

candidates.name: uniform_m150_m200_m350_m400
candidates.rationale: average both high-score neighborhoods while preserving two late modes

candidates.name: uniform_m150_m200_m250_m300_m350_m400
candidates.rationale: broad late-run stochastic weight average across the full evaluated continuation

evaluation.panel: fixed development validation 8 tasks x 50 official init states
evaluation.pairing: identical state, environment seed, policy seed, noise, and teacher-video assignment across candidates and the raw curve

decision_rule.primary: correct400 absolute performance and multi-task breadth relative to raw macro200
decision_rule.paired_evidence: report gained/lost paired episodes and exact two-sided sign test
decision_rule.specificity: a winning average must undergo the existing five-arm and internal transmission checks before becoming an AS observed best
decision_rule.failure_next_step: if no candidate improves the raw best credibly, run a fresh learning-rate and optimizer stabilization experiment before changing the v6 compiler
